text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Apparently people from the shopping district in Kokura are coming to see the race today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Kokura's so far from here. Why would they bother?
choice_data_list: Because getting to root for you is worth any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Grrr… Again with your cheesy remarks…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But it's true they're all rooting for me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …I have to win, then. After all, their support is what led me here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I have to give it my all… no matter how fast the others are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's probably talking about Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having gained new rivals, Nice Nature is… fired up!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I can't let them see me fail.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I can do it… I can run just as fast as those runners!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll run with all I got—all the way to the top of the podium!
